input:
Repository: acme/accounts
Issue number: 118
Title: Password reset tokens remain valid after use

Body:
After a user successfully resets their password, the same reset token can be
submitted again and changes the password a second time. A reset token must be
invalidated immediately after the first successful reset. Add a regression test
covering reuse of a consumed token.

Labels:
bug, security

Relevant comments:
Comment by maintainer: Existing unused tokens must continue to expire after 30
minutes. Do not change the expiration window.

output.summary: Prevent reuse of consumed password reset tokens.
output.problem_statement: A password reset token remains valid after a successful password reset, allowing the token to change the password more than once.
requirements: Invalidate a password reset token immediately after its first successful use.
Preserve the existing 30-minute expiration behavior for unused tokens.
Add regression coverage for attempted reuse of a consumed token.
acceptance_criteria: The first valid submission of a password reset token successfully resets the password.
A second submission of the same consumed token is rejected and does not change the password.
An unused reset token continues to expire after 30 minutes.
Automated tests cover reuse of a consumed token.
out_of_scope: Changing the 30-minute expiration window for unused tokens.

risks.description: Failure to invalidate tokens atomically could leave a race condition that permits concurrent reuse.

output.actionability_reason: The faulty behavior, required behavior, preserved behavior, and regression-test expectation are explicit.

input:
Repository: acme/storefront
Issue number: 203
Title: Make product search better

Body:
Search feels slow and the results are not very good. Improve it.

Labels:
enhancement

Relevant comments:
Comment by product-owner: Customers should find what they want more easily.

output.summary: Improve product-search performance and result quality, pending clarification of measurable targets.
output.problem_statement: The issue reports that product search feels slow and returns unsatisfactory results, but does not define the affected queries or expected behavior.
requirements: Improve the relevance of product-search results.
open_questions: What response-time target or baseline defines an acceptable performance improvement?
Which queries currently produce poor results?
How should result relevance be measured or ranked?
Does the issue apply to all product searches or a specific search surface?

risks.description: Implementing without measurable relevance and latency targets could produce a change that cannot be objectively accepted.

output.actionability_reason: The issue lacks measurable performance targets, examples of incorrect results, and a definition of expected relevance.
